scope: Public-source and retained inventory synthesis only;not proposal implementation,review disposition or runtime acceptance.

commits.message: Compose retained lossless DSP savings with instrument lifecycle fixes
fix(ui): hide unavailable SCALE cues on clip questions
feat(runtime): retain Drone archives in a disabled DSP profile

source_intake.provenance: Authenticated connected GitHub read-only fetches. Source blobs are whole-file remote identities even when only named line ranges were consumed.

actual_label_and_profile_limits: Actual dynamic engine labels,native ADSR and engine-specific glyph/pages are pre-existing;not candidate improvements.

#931 ea10fb14 defaults X0X_DRONE_RUNTIME_ENABLED=0,preserves valid Drone archive cell/tag identity and returns unavailable/silent runtime;do not describe old four-audible-engine map as latest shipping availability.
Current source already has ENGINE UNAVAILABLE request rejection. No newly designed persistent engine-availability LCD label is claimed as current.
Chicago/Miami/Juno parameter routes are useful source baselines;existing Drone page/schema data remain archival/optional-profile context.

counting.convention: Source-derived logical gestures,not measured time,encoder calibration or musician performance. One unused tap=down+up;one complete hold/release=one gesture;chord physical presses stated separately;one accepted K2 sign event=one page. Start state,page memory,held owners and model/build gates are mandatory.
counting.input_count_inventory: 35 retained R4 access tasks +11 detailed P01–P11 cases;not35 new tests or executed speed claims.

groups.goal: First audible beat, then an intentional drum edit
groups.start: 909 SEQ, known empty working pattern, REC off, established output/clock; BD selected
route: Tap W1/W5/W9/W13 once
Press SEQ PLAY
Select SD with black2=G#3, PARA, K7 DECAY if desired
groups.count: Beat:4 step gestures +1 PLAY press =5. Add1 BD-selection gesture if not selected. SD correction from its remembered first sound row:1 track selection +1 PARA +1 turn =3.
groups.actual: Drum track selection/audition and step writing are different. Running REC-off selection need not add or audition a hit. Keep real kit/track values and direct sound-page control.
groups.feedback: Content dim base, current/held/playhead layers follow source priority; REC lamp is arm only. No pad light proves recorded or saved.
groups.retain: Keep the 16-step surface, 11-track drum selection and native per-voice controls.
groups.opportunity: Name SELECT TRACK / AUDITION / WRITE context without adding a mode-confirmation detour; complete the beat by listening to replay, not by seeing steps.
groups.gate: Audible monitoring and physical velocity remain unqualified here.

groups.goal: Explore the actual sound, then choose another preset deliberately
groups.start: Selected supported melodic slot, REC off, no held input/question, known remembered page
route: PARA enters remembered sound page
K2 moves both directions through engine-specific pages
SOUND: K5 ENGINE, K6 PRESET, K7 read-only STATUS; K4 also changes requested preset
groups.count: From SEQ with the first sound page remembered: PARA +K2 reverse1 to SOUND +K6 turn =3 gestures for available Chicago/Miami/Juno. From Chicago OSCILLATOR to EFFECT:2 reverse K2 events +K5 turn =3.
groups.actual: Dynamic engine labels and engine-specific page/glyph/ADSR vocabulary already exist. Engine/preset turns submit requests; universal inert browsing/reversible audition is not established.
groups.feedback: PARA view LED; real status and old sounding identity must be distinguished from requested choice. Blank/read-only columns stay unavailable.
groups.retain: Current sparse four-knob matrix and full page cycles; do not substitute generic diagnostics or claim dynamic naming as new.
groups.opportunity: Unify target/scope hierarchy and real native glyphs. Keep current sound versus request explicit; detailed pending/Keep cases stay reserved.
groups.gate: Seven CP1 cases and Keep/native user-bank policy excluded. #931 default Drone DSP availability differs from archived identity; no newly invented current LCD label.

groups.goal: Record a phrase, stop, correct and perform another take
groups.start: Selected melodic V_SEQ, known pattern/cursor/rate/direction, stopped, REC off; supported engine available
route: SEQ REC press arms and resets selected melodic write cursor
Play and release N deliberate notes/chord onsets for stopped step entry
SEQ REC press disarms
For running take add PLAY start and PLAY stop, then inspect/replay before retry
groups.count: Stopped take:2 REC presses +N note gestures. Running take adds2 PLAY presses. Counts exclude context selection, chord-size changes and listening duration.
groups.actual: Current physical bass_write/bass_kbd stores BASS_VELOCITY_DEFAULT; live audition velocity is not universal recorded onset velocity. External MIDI/SMC REC uses source masks/channels; input endpoints are not one universal recorder.
groups.feedback: Red REC means ui.rec armed. A heard onset, moving playhead, input acknowledgement or arm lamp is not stored-note proof. Refused direction/chord/note-sound paths remain visible source facts.
groups.retain: Useful stopped step entry and running recording; existing duration/endpoint/lifecycle fixes are retained source context, not rerun proof.
groups.opportunity: Show actual current mode, target, cursor and accepted/rejected pass evidence; provide a correction/replay/retry journey. Do not declare the future exclusive capture class chosen.
groups.gate: CP2 strategy depends on CP1; CP3 lifecycle depends on selected CP2. Full37 expressive capture and repeated-take burden remain design/verification requirements, not current success claims.

groups.goal: Correct one held step, then return to the base sound
groups.start: Known existing step and sound page preselected; REC off, no overlay
route: From V_SEQ hold original W5/pad4 step05
PARA enters retained sound page while step stays held
Turn target K5–K8 for eligible p-lock
Release original step; next turn edits base
Held step +K2 edits chance; melodic held step +K3 edits velocity
groups.count: Known SEQ/page:1 hold/release +1 PARA +1 turn =3. R4 P06 adds SEQ entry and post-release base turn for5 total. Chance from known held step:1 hold +1 K2 turn =2.
groups.actual: K2 while held is probability, not page browsing. Preselect sound page first. Page/bank/octave/rate are context-sensitive; held original owner controls release.
groups.feedback: Selected step, held marker, lock and base value need distinct text/geometry. No keybed LEDs; physical pad colour does not encode all scopes.
groups.retain: Original owner binding, 64-step paging, scalar editing without extra confirm and source K2/K3 overrides.
groups.opportunity: Persistent STEP05/track/scope cue plus clear return-to-base; keep all editable native controls visible.
groups.gate: No test/replay of held-transition timing or collision correctness in this audit.

groups.goal: Record motion, override it for a pass, and remove only the intended lane
groups.start: Running pattern and known eligible engine parameter page
route: REC on:turn the parameter to record its lane
REC off:turn an existing lane parameter for a one-pass hold
Hold BT and turn that parameter to clear its lane
In held-step scope the same BT+turn clears that one p-lock instead
groups.count: Known target:1 turn for record/override;1 BT hold +1 turn =2 for lane clear. REC toggle adds1 press when needed.
groups.actual: Only R_ENG playing routes motion; target is engine_motion_part, not necessarily visible part for shared controls. Full capacity says MOTION FULL; stationary control is not a write.
groups.feedback: Show base/playing motion/temporary override/lock separately; used BT release is consumed and must not save.
groups.retain: Direct four-knob, wheel and fader destinations plus pickup and original ownership.
groups.opportunity: Show named destination and stored-versus-live scope beside native controls, with refusal that preserves unrelated lanes.
groups.gate: Future capture-class motion policy stays CP2/CP3 dependent.

groups.goal: Explore BREAK slices and return to the groove
groups.start: BREAK LOOPS, known bank/slot/sample identity; no held input
route: K5 changes LOOP A; K6 LOOP B; remaining actual page refs retain their scope
SEQ to remembered SEQUENCE, K2 to GROOVE, K7 ROLL
Hold live slices/reverse/stutter and release original owners
groups.count: R4 P10:LOOP A turn +SEQ +K2 +ROLL turn =4 gestures. Slice performance cost depends on exact onset/release schedule.
groups.actual: Last-held live slice overrides generator; release restores source-defined generator route. LOOP A/B/B CHANCE are pattern refs; PITCH is sound ref. Physical audition is not a universal BREAK recording promise.
groups.feedback: Requested sample/bank, actual fallback source, active slice and live override differ; no false recorded flash.
groups.retain: Loops, slice/groove/retrigger controls and four live lower controls.
groups.opportunity: Native bank/slot/slice identity and explicit release destination; complete multi-slice phrase and recovery to groove.
groups.gate: Physical BREAK capture proposal and sample portability/atomicity remain unqualified; capture-class choice not selected.

groups.goal: Generate a useful variation without misrepresenting destructive replacement
groups.start: Eligible Chicago/Miami generator context; current pattern understood
route: ARP enters generator
OCTAVE+ produces NEW LINE with seed
OCTAVE− mutates current line
Use existing history route if admissible
groups.count: From eligible non-generator view:ARP +OCTAVE action =2 gestures; already in generator =1.
groups.actual: Current NEW LINE/mutate edits the live current pattern and marks dirty; it is not an inert preview buffer.
groups.feedback: Generator page/seed and changed pattern must remain explicit; no unchanged/original badge after actual mutation.
groups.retain: Source generator controls and existing Undo constraints.
groups.opportunity: R22 random-preview/adopt comparison remains a new design capability needing staging, memory and correction proof.
groups.gate: No invented preview implementation or one-tap whole-take undo guarantee.

groups.goal: Copy the audible multi-part idea to a safe destination
groups.start: Current source slots per part known; destination bank visible
route: Hold BT
Press chosen destination white key/pad
If occupied, SCALE confirms or PATCH cancels
Release used BT without extra save
groups.count: Empty destination:2 physical press/hold gestures. Occupied destination adds1 confirm or cancel tap =3; bank selection adds BT+OCTAVE context action.
groups.actual: Copies all five parts from their respective current source slots. Occupied destination asks; partial motion capacity can yield MOTION FULL: NOT ALL PASTED.
groups.feedback: Exact source/destination/scope; do not call partial copy complete or consumed BT a save.
groups.retain: Fast combo and contextual confirmation.
groups.opportunity: Show five-part source tuple and copy/overwrite result without replacing direct performance controls.
groups.gate: No bytes/data comparison or undo round-trip executed.

groups.goal: Save the current idea, recognise delay/failure, then retry deliberately
groups.start: Any ordinary UI context, project not in transfer, unused BT gesture
route: Short unused BT release requests save
If running, stop; disarm REC; release/retire actual note/transfer/clip owners
Wait for eligible safe write and inspect exact result
On actual failure keep RAM work and use a fresh explicit retry
groups.count: Request=1 tap. From RUN+REC on, readiness can add PLAY stop +REC off =2 presses; owners/quiet time prevent a fixed completion count.
groups.actual: Source statuses SAVED/UNSAVED/QUEUED/FAILED and SAVE AT STOP/REC OFF TO SAVE/SAVE WHEN QUIET already exist. Explicit request queues latest live data until safe; request acknowledgement is not completion.
groups.feedback: BT queued steady, unsaved ui.frame8 blink, failure ui.frame2 blink, saved off under current source. Text/geometry must disambiguate; binary lamp cannot show invented colour/breathing.
groups.retain: Current feedback and safe write conditions, including autosave quiet/gap and newer-data/memory errors.
groups.opportunity: Persistent compact actual blocker/outcome with selected target preserved; never turn stopped/refused/requested into durability.
groups.gate: Seven CP1 cases and transactional result lifecycle reserved. No save/reload, flash fault, power-loss or safe-power-off proof.

groups.goal: Recover a saved idea or reject an unsafe replacement
groups.start: Project LOAD row already selected through reserved Settings component
route: Clean LOAD:SCALE sends action directly
Dirty LOAD:SCALE opens question;SCALE confirms or PATCH cancels
Normal unmodified PLAY cancels and issues start/stop;clip PLAY delegates
Successful staged load resets to909 SEQ;failed/refused load retains current project/context per source
groups.count: At selected row:clean1 tap;dirty open+confirm/cancel2 taps. PLAY cancellation1 press after question. Full Settings navigation counts remain with R2 producer.
groups.actual: Source validates/stages before apply. LOAD can refuse for more than transport, so STOP PLAYING TO LOAD is not a full causal diagnosis. Reset/import/load and sound/sample/project scopes differ.
groups.feedback: #930 removes unavailable physical SCALE YES cue/LED on clip questions while keeping PATCH NO; SMC confirmation route is a separate source path.
groups.retain: Staging/refusal protection and truthful returned view; backup files/samples need their own content/readback contract.
groups.opportunity: Explicit consequence and preserved-old-data wording; retain originals and show version/asset limits at recovery boundaries.
groups.gate: Private Settings payload is referenced, not copied. Host/file librarian and device transfer remain incumbent scopes; no restore/update/device execution.

groups.goal: Turn a live sequence into an explicit durable arrangement
groups.start: HOME stopped, no overlay/pending-sound navigation consumption
route: PATCH enters SONG
White key/pad writes all-part pattern at selected bar and advances cursor
Use two BAR pages for per-part patterns and repeats; black keys toggle bar mutes
BT requests project save after deliberate edits
groups.count: HOME→SONG1 tap;one all-part bar assignment1 pad gesture;save request1 tap =3 before readiness. Per-part/repeat edits add actual turns/page moves; no fixed complete-song count.
groups.actual: Current Song max192 bars, repeats1–8, two BAR pages and11-bar overview are useful. Live chain is transient and not serialized by Save everything.
groups.feedback: Show selected bar versus playing bar, empty entry versus stored bar, repeat and mute content. Do not light an empty song bar as stored.
groups.retain: Current Song authoring, overview and native parameter controls.
groups.opportunity: A concise LIVE CHAIN→durable SONG teaching route; proposed Keep chain as Song is a future conversion, not an existing serializer.
groups.gate: CP2/CP3 capture/conversion contract remains open; source-only save request does not prove persistence.

groups.goal: Capture an arrangement performance, inspect it, correct it and repeat
groups.start: HOME stopped, intended start bar selected/known and existing Song protected
route: PATCH to SONG
REC arms
PLAY starts using stopped view's source authority
Perform N intentional pattern/mute changes
PLAY stops;REC disarms;inspect bars and edit/undo only known scope
groups.count: From stated HOME start:PATCH+REC+PLAY start+PLAY stop+REC off =5 control presses/taps, plus N performance gestures; protect/restore/compare adds context-specific actions.
groups.actual: seq.song_rec follows seq.song_on && ui.rec. Source Song recording stores pattern/mute/length, not full audio or all FX. Physical, external-note and motion paths still share broader ui.rec semantics.
groups.feedback: SONG/PATTERNS authority, recording scope, selected/playing bar and existing-content replacement must be readable; REC lamp alone cannot explain which domains write.
groups.retain: Useful baseline Song capture and immediate mute dirty marking.
groups.opportunity: Provide a full take→inspect→correct→repeat→save journey without freezing separated/combined future capture strategy.
groups.gate: Selected CP2 strategy and CP3 lifecycle must resolve before dependent proposal can claim ready capture.

groups.goal: Perform queued variations and mutes with a known next boundary
groups.start: HOME or part/SEQ with known current patterns, QUEUE MUTES preference known
route: HOME pad/white key cues pattern(all parts);K4 in PART/SEQ cues current part
HOME black key toggles whole-part mute
PATCH+drum black key toggles one track mute
SMC REW/FWD accumulates from pending target;opposite return to current cancels
groups.count: HOME cue1 gesture;whole-part mute1;drum-track mute2 physical presses;SMC delta1 per accepted button event.
groups.actual: Selected/current/queued are different. Adoption follows actual source bar/part policy; stopped cues apply at next audio advance. Queue mutes only queues when option enabled and running.
groups.feedback: Keep content, held/playhead, pending and mute markers distinct. Existing normal pads share selected-part hue; no per-contained-part pad colour claim. LCD STOP/WAIT cue static intent is separate from source cue-pad blink.
groups.retain: Direct cue/mute routes, real content and source boundary.
groups.opportunity: Per-part now→next and separate mute intent, readable in collisions; optional motion only with admitted musical activity.
groups.gate: Pending adoption fidelity and autonomous LED/audio timing not measured here.

groups.goal: Shape a five-part performance without losing useful lower controls
groups.start: HOME, MIX or FX, ordinary UI, no overlay/held modifier
route: HOME K5 TEMPO/K6 SWING/K7 FILTER/K8 PUMP
NOTE REPEAT enters MIX, repeated taps/K2 cycle five pages
FX enters REVERB/DELAY;K2 reverse route retained
Faders/wheels use actual bank/pickup targets
groups.count: HOME control:0 navigation+1 turn. Enter known FX/MIX then edit:1 tap+1 turn =2. R4 P09 master PUMP from MIX PARTS:2 reverse page events+K7 =3.
groups.actual: Four PERFORM controls and full current mixer/FX pages already exist; dynamic engine label/native ADSR are retained baseline, not new benefits.
groups.feedback: Keep values/units/pickup and actual target; no prose diagnostic panel displaces playable controls.
groups.retain: Whole ensemble overview, direct lower controls, reverse page access and sparse mapping.
groups.opportunity: Cohesive hierarchy, common glyph materials and compact power/transport status while preserving exactly these functions.
groups.gate: Latency/deadline/native-resource/audio acceptance cannot be inferred from source or gesture counts.

groups.goal: Use SMC follow/lock/peek and held effects without stealing another target
groups.start: Supported connected SMC build, current mapped target known
route: Pause press while following captures targets
Short Pause press while locked peeks
A fresh locked Pause hold≥900ms unlocks
Known FX bus button hold applies/release retires original effect;BRK-strip REC requests next-bar fill
groups.count: Lock1 press;peek1 tap;unlock1 complete hold;known FX throw1 hold/release. Connection/reselection and alternate peer context add variable actions.
groups.actual: Physical Pause is context lock, MMC STOP remains transport. Buttons keep normal actions while fader/knob targets stay locked. Fill is momentary,next 909 bar,release/leaveFX ends request.
groups.feedback: Locked target/follow state distinct from STOP. Preserve exact ROOM/TIGHT/ECHO assignments and eight spatial buses; no new fake controller-light colours.
groups.retain: Captured ownership, original effect release, exact source supported-build/multi-peer envelope.
groups.opportunity: Show keyboard selection and captured SMC target together without cancelling lock to navigate; clearly separate requested fill from active progress.
groups.gate: Peer reconnect/fault-detail cases remain incumbent scope; no physical controller test or new connection performed.

groups.goal: Launch Loopy clips and release the original cell after viewport changes
groups.start: Standalone, no active transaction, host mapping/feedback understood
route: KNOB BANK rising press toggles clip mode
Press visible occupied pad
OCTAVE−/+ changes bounded local viewport
Release original pad;stored note determines note-off
KNOB BANK press exits and releases owned clip notes
groups.count: Enter1 press;launch/hold1 gesture;viewport move1 per press;exit1. No hold deadline is present in current clip toggle source.
groups.actual: Sixteen physical pads are a viewport of host APC cells, not all host clips. Clip transport/history intercept normal PLAY/REC. Host palette/feedback owns pad state; local optimistic transport feedback is not host success.
groups.feedback: Show request versus host-confirmed/stale state; preserve original release owner while current viewport display updates.
groups.retain: Exact entry/exit flush, clip keybed SCALE/CHORD/ARP route, viewport fold/trim/flip and no off-viewport access promise.
groups.opportunity: Make mode/host scope/await-feedback legible without inventing a new standalone engine or assuming a held toggle.
groups.gate: Host launch/audio/control binding unrun. Historical emulator captures are not execution of accepted latest source.

groups.goal: Recognise clock preference, loss, WAIT and rejoin
groups.start: Clock source row/active source known; running pattern or explicit stopped state
route: At selected CLOCK SOURCE row,K3/arrow changes preference
EXTERNAL loss retains place and WAIT;AUTO may fallback by source policy
Accepted new clocks rejoin source observer;pending cue remains until actual adoption
groups.count: Known row:1 value gesture. Full Settings navigation belongs to R2. Waiting/rejoin is an event, not an extra hidden button count.
groups.actual: Clock preference, measured active source and actual clock progress differ. Request start does not prove advancing clock. Clip mode forces its source-defined AUTO clock policy.
groups.feedback: LCD musical beat neutral/static in STOP/WAIT; standalone PLAY LED slow WAIT blink uses UI frames. Keep these separate;source pad queued blink may continue.
groups.retain: Current source filtering/lock/loss semantics and readable tempo.
groups.opportunity: Persistent explicit WAIT/fallback/active-source identity that does not simulate beats from wall time.
groups.gate: No seamless phase, perceptual blink or physical clock-rejoin acceptance.

groups.goal: Retire stranded notes and make a fresh musical recovery
groups.start: Known keyboard/clip/SMC context and original held inputs
route: Keyboard FX+SEQ chord requests notes-off;release both
Fresh note acquires a new generation
Clip NOTE REPEAT panic and SMC DAW bankL+bankR use their own scoped routes
Use PLAY separately when transport stop is actually desired
groups.count: Keyboard panic2 physical presses(one chord)+releases;fresh played note1 gesture. SMC bank chord2 presses only in admitted DAW context.
groups.actual: Panic is notes-off retirement, not guaranteed global silence, STOP, FX-tail cutoff or an external-device reset. Source consumes chord member releases to avoid accidental page changes.
groups.feedback: Show actual retired scope and fresh-input recovery; no generic success toast that implies stopped transport.
groups.retain: Exact gesture/context and source generation fencing.
groups.opportunity: A brief scoped receipt and a playable next-note checkpoint; navigation continuity versus intentional engine/panic cuts remains explicit.
groups.gate: No device or sustained-note/audio recovery test; do not broaden panic authority.

groups.goal: Adjust Settings safely and see truthful power status during use
groups.start: Current ordinary musical context; Settings component reserved
route: Use accepted R2 category/value/action/back/modal routes unchanged
Return to musical view with source session-focus reset understood
Compact top power status uses actual0..3/USB/unknown semantics
groups.count: Settings full route counts remain owned by producer;no candidate-added confirmation for scalar. Battery is read-only,not an action.
groups.actual: Settings is an existing six-section surface. Power source does not supply calibrated percentage or proven charging state/model support.
groups.feedback: #930 masks physical SCALE affirmative cue/LED in clip questions;all 37keys/16pads do not acquire fictitious LEDs. Compact power must not displace musical identity/tempo.
groups.retain: R2 component and exact receipt,physical captions,existing help and native glyph vocabulary.
groups.opportunity: Integrate accepted component visually and keep truthful normal-use power visible; percentage-inside-icon remains unsupported.
groups.gate: No Settings redesign/private payload copy;USB/unknown/charging assumptions remain bounded.

groups.goal: Make feedback/tutorial meaning survive the complete musical journey
groups.start: Any admitted musical journey above,including simultaneous/held/queued states
route: Retain native glyph-first parameter and ensemble information
Make accepted state transitions refresh without another corrective input
Teach exact physical route on website and instrument
After correction,replay,repeat and recovery compare data/audio/LCD/requestedLED/sentLED/durablestate separately
groups.count: No fabricated speed benefit. Existing35 access tasks and11 detailed P01–P11 counts remain baseline;changes require same-start comparison.
groups.actual: Current labels,glyphs,ADSR,overview,button hints and confirmations already do useful work. Static source/proposals cannot establish autonomous physical feedback or final whole-instrument usefulness.
groups.feedback: RGB selected-part hue/host palette/binary button meanings remain distinct; geometry/text resolves collisions; no keybedLED assumption.
groups.retain: All39 retained journeys and261 R22 routing rows,including deferred/nonvisual owners.
groups.opportunity: Judge coherent whole workflows and real function loss,not number of screens. Every displacement needs retained/replaced/control-count rationale.
groups.gate: Comparator adoption,DF1,current native qualification,resource/physical proof and full-design acceptance remain open.

settings_private_receipt.consumption: Parent's accepted visual intake/receipt reference only;no private payload copied into this audit.

reserved.capture_dependency: CP1 decision→CP2 selected strategy→CP3 lifecycle;current useful baseline routes remain available without choosing future policy.

not_run: No new renders or proposal edits.
No emulator,interaction test,broad suite or independent review run.
No firmware build,device operation or runtime edit.
No Git/Library write or new agent.

coverage_arithmetic.meaning: Inventory arithmetic only;not interaction or firmware verification.
